name: Stephen A. Mitchell
shortBio: American psychoanalyst and psychologist who founded Relational Psychoanalysis, synthesizing interpersonal psychoanalysis and British object relations into a co-constructed two-person field.
centralQuestion: How does replacing classical drive theory with a relational matrix transform psychoanalysis into an interactive, mutually negotiated two-person intersubjective field?

keyWorks.title: Object Relations in Psychoanalytic Theory
keyWorks.description: Co-authored with Jay Greenberg, establishing the fundamental distinction between drive/structural and relational/conflict paradigms.

keyWorks.title: Relational Concepts in Psychoanalysis: An Integration
keyWorks.description: Articulates the core relational paradigm where mind is constituted within an intersubjective matrix.

keyWorks.title: Hope and Dread in Psychoanalysis
keyWorks.description: Explores clinical enactments, the dialectic of agency and surrender, and the co-construction of meaning.
